import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def want(req,ev,pol,expected):
    req0=copy.deepcopy(req); ev0=copy.deepcopy(ev); pol0=copy.deepcopy(pol)
    got=evaluate(req,ev,pol)
    assert got==expected,(got,expected)
    assert (req,ev,pol)==(req0,ev0,pol0), 'inputs modified'

p={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}
want({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1}},[],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']})
want({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},[{'source':'u','claim':'x','value':7,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':False},{'source':'w','claim':'x','value':8,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True}],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
want({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},[{'source':'s1','claim':'x','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'s2','claim':'x','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['s1','s2'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
want({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},[{'source':'s1','claim':'x','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'s2','claim':'x','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['s1']}],p,{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['s2'],'unknowns':[]})
want({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},[{'source':'s','claim':'x','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['s'],'unknowns':[]})
want({'claim':'x','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},[{'source':'s','claim':'x','value':{'z':1,'a':[2]},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'t','claim':'x','value':{'a':[2],'z':1},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'supported','value':{'z':1,'a':[2]},'sources':['s','t'],'unknowns':[]})
with open('requests.json') as f:r=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f:e=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f:p0=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f:report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(x,e,p0) for x in r],report
print('all checks passed')

import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(request,evidence,policy,expected):
    before=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))
    actual=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
    assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
    assert (request,evidence,policy)==before
    assert set(actual)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'}

check({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},[],{'required_conditions':['z','a']},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','z']})
check({'claim':'c','conditions':{'k':1}},[{'source':'a','claim':'c','conditions':{'k':1},'value':None},{'source':'b','claim':'c','conditions':{'k':1},'value':None}],{'required_conditions':['k']},{'status':'supported','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]})
check({'claim':'c','conditions':{'k':1}},[{'source':'old','claim':'c','conditions':{'k':1},'value':1},{'source':'new','claim':'c','conditions':{'k':1},'value':2,'supersedes':['old']}],{'required_conditions':['k']},{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
check({'claim':'c','conditions':{'k':1}},[{'source':'a','claim':'c','conditions':{'k':1},'value':[1,{'x':2}]},{'source':'b','claim':'c','conditions':{'k':1},'value':[1,{'x':3}]}],{'required_conditions':['k']},{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))
assert report==[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
print('extended checks passed')
